items.title: DALL·E now available in beta
items.summary: We’ll invite 1 million people from our waitlist over the coming weeks. Users can create with DALL·E using free credits that refill every month, and buy additional credits in 115-generation increments for $15.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布其图像生成模型DALL·E正式开放公测，计划在数周内邀请候补名单中的100万用户体验。用户每月可获得免费生成额度，并可按需购买额外生成次数，标志着该多模态模型向大众市场迈出重要一步。原始信息显示：We’ll invite 1 million people from our waitlist over the coming weeks. Users can create with DALL·E using free credits that refill every month, and buy additional credits in 115-generation increments for $15.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“DALL·E now available in beta”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI宣布DALL-E正式进入公测阶段并公布收费与配额方案，是多模态生成模型商业化落地的关键进展。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
